summary: I sent the scripted prompt. Claude Code loaded hyperpowers:writing-plans, read the spec, src/ui, the pages and the tests, and wrote docs/hyperpowers/plans/2026-10-02-deploys-page.md. The plan builds the Deploys page from the library: dataTable, selectField, filterBar, statusChip, emptyState and pageHeader. It says outright that it does not copy the hand-written Services page. The only file the agent wrote or edited was the plan; git diff HEAD is empty.
reasoning: All four criteria are backed by the session log and by what is on disk. The agent asked no clarifying questions, so I never had to give any of the scripted answers.

observations.description: On first launch, the workspace-trust and bypass-permissions dialogs both have "No, exit" selected by default. This is expected for safety, but it means the harness has to press Down to get past them.
The plan is not committed because .gitignore excludes docs/hyperpowers/. The agent pointed this out, which was helpful, but someone could easily miss that the plan is untracked.

The agent's closing message starts with leftover text about Codex ("/codex:setup") and says "Codex wasn't available, so the only review was my own check". This is noise for someone who only asked for a plan.

The agent dry-ran the plan's code in a temporary copy of the repo and fixed one wrong test assumption it found. This is good. It also listed the spec gaps it filled (default sort directions, the ?env= value for All, the empty-state wording) so the user can review them.
Partway through planning, the agent ran an 'ungated-ledger append' script from the plugin's requesting-code-review skill. It is not clear why a planning-only request writes to a ledger.

criteria.evidence: First tool_use in the session log is {"name":"Skill","i":"{\"skill\":\"hyperpowers:writing-plans\"}"}. The screen showed "Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill".
`ls docs/hyperpowers/plans` returned 2026-10-02-deploys-page.md (476 lines). The agent told me: "The plan is at docs/hyperpowers/plans/2026-10-02-deploys-page.md".

criteria.criterion: Plan's page code calls dataTable and selectField, with no hand-written <table>/<select>
criteria.evidence: Step 7 of the plan imports `{ dataTable, emptyState, esc, filterBar, pageHeader, selectField, statusChip } from '../ui/index.js'` and calls `filterBar({... fields: [selectField({ name: 'env', ...})]})` and `dataTable({ columns: COLUMNS, rows: deploys, sort, sortHref, empty: emptyState(...) })`. grep for `<table` and `<select` in the plan matches only test assertions (lines 203 and 226), not page code. The Architecture line says it is "built entirely from the vendored component library in src/ui/".

criteria.criterion: No source/test/data/public file created or changed
criteria.evidence: `git status --porcelain --ignored` prints only `!! docs/` (the plan, in a gitignored dir). `git diff HEAD | wc -l` prints 0. Every Write/Edit file_path in the session log is .../docs/hyperpowers/plans/2026-10-02-deploys-page.md. The dry run of the plan's code was done in a mktemp copy (`D=$(mktemp -d); cp -R . $D/r`).
